reference.operation: Space and Compact have empty public ComponentToken records; Compact ignores ConfigProvider.space and omits its own cssVar class, so component alias probes apply only to regular Space. Native provider DOM variable inheritance is outside that comparison. CSS aliases/algorithms and padding presets preserve inherited typography. ConfigProvider.space size, class/style and root/item/separator object/function slots: normalized callback props, local/preset/numeric/zero gaps, semantic/plain style priority, RTL, nested/replaced/empty/inherited/reset/sibling records. Source font/color and alias probe are measured separately; native snippets/items and keyed state are verified independently.
